customManagers.description: GitHub runner versions in shell scripts and YAML within workflows

npm packages pinned via pre-commit additional_dependencies (e.g. @commitlint/config-conventional@N in .pre-commit-config.yaml). The built-in pre-commit manager only bumps the `rev:` on each hook — it doesn't touch the additional_dependencies array, so without this regex those pins go stale forever.
Renovate npm package version pinned in CI workflows

APT packages pinned in Debian 13 (trixie) Dockerfiles. depName excludes '_' to avoid matching Python kwargs like 'exist_ok=True'. Uses the built-in `deb` datasource pointing at deb.debian.org for the main trixie suite; the trixie-updates and trixie-security suites Debian publishes only as .xz (unsupported by the built-in deb datasource — upstream renovatebot/renovate#35865) so we route those two through our github-apt-helper.keneli.org proxy (see additionalRegistryUrls in the packageRule below). Bearer-token auth for the proxy is injected out-of-band: Mend's Renovate uses an org-level Host Rule (bakerkj org Credentials → Host Rules); the renovate-validate CI dry-run uses a RENOVATE_HOST_RULES env-var overlay (see .github/workflows/renovate-validate.yaml).

Tag-pinned WeeWX deps from GitHub archive zips — bundled extensions in build/extensions.txt, `weewx_ha` (the MQTT publisher by felddy) in pyproject.toml, and the rtgd URL in build/install_rtgd.py. The xstats ADD in the Dockerfile uses raw.githubusercontent.com instead of /archive/<tag>.zip, so it's tracked by the companion 'raw.githubusercontent.com' manager below.

Tag-pinned files fetched via raw.githubusercontent.com — the xstats ADD in the Dockerfile (single source file pulled from a tag rather than a /archive/<tag>.zip), and the addon-linter schema URLs in .pre-commit-config.yaml's check-jsonschema hook. Tracked against github-tags so a new upstream release bumps the pin.

home-assistant/builder sub-action pin in addon-build.yaml. Renovate's built-in github-actions manager picks up `uses: owner/repo@vX.Y` but doesn't reliably track the `owner/repo/path/to/action@CalVer` form against github-tags, so handle it explicitly. With `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver` enabled the line takes the form `@<40-char-sha> # <CalVer>`; capture digest + version separately so renovate edits the right span on a bump instead of splicing a semver into the middle of the SHA.

SHA-pinned WeeWX deps on default branch 'master'. None of these repos tag releases; tracked via git-refs against the branch HEAD. Renovate writes the full 40-char SHA on bump (GitHub archive URLs accept either 7 or 40). The companion rule below handles repos whose default branch is 'main'.
SHA-pinned WeeWX deps on default branch 'main'. See the 'master' companion rule above for the rationale.
rtldavis Go binary SHA pinned via ARG RTLDAVIS_REF in the multi-stage Dockerfile builder. Upstream lheijst/rtldavis has no release tags; tracked via git-refs against the master HEAD.
uv build tool, bind-mounted into the Dockerfile build (RUN --mount=from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:<version>). Renovate's docker manager doesn't parse --mount=from, so it's matched here.
uv tool required-version pin in pyproject.toml [tool.uv] (companion to the Dockerfile bind-mount pin above — keeps setup-uv on the same uv major.minor in CI).

packageRules.description: Group both uv pins (Dockerfile bind-mount + pyproject.toml [tool.uv] required-version) so a uv bump lands in one PR.

Silent-refresh policy for the plain `debian` image (rtldavis-builder stage): accept minor and major tag bumps (13.6 → 13.7, 13.x → 14.0) but drop digest-only PRs. Docker Hub rebuilds `13.x` in place for CVE refreshes, which shows up as digest updates that don't communicate what changed. Point releases already bundle the accumulated rebuilds, so nothing is lost — the interstitial rebuilds get swept up on the next tag bump.

Constrain ghcr.io/home-assistant/base-debian bumps to the trixie-CalVer line. Regex versioning parses the prefixed tag directly (trixie-YYYY.MM.PATCH) and ignores bookworm-* tags or the rolling `:trixie`/`:latest`, which don't match. Default `docker` versioning can't parse the prefix.

Force loose versioning for home-assistant/builder — its release tags are CalVer (YYYY.MM.PATCH), not SemVer. The `helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver` preset re-applies semver at packageRule level (higher priority than the customManager's local versioningTemplate), which mis-orders CalVer patches and produces bogus bumps (see hass-apps PRs #246, #248). This override wins.

Group all apt-package updates into one PR. Also overrides the customManager's single registryUrlTemplate with the full list of three URLs — main trixie direct from deb.debian.org, plus trixie-updates + trixie-security via our github-apt-helper.keneli.org proxy (Debian publishes those two only as .xz, unsupported by the built-in deb datasource — upstream renovatebot/renovate#35865). Renovate merges lookups across the three registries.

Pin Python to the 3.13 series — it must match python3 in the Debian trixie base image. Bumping to 3.14 makes uv build a standalone 3.14 venv that mismatches the base's apt python3 (broke the build). Lift this when the base moves to a Debian release with 3.14.
